leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a reactive notification state using Vue's ref or reactive API
Implement a notification component that renders messages with different types (success, error, warning)
Configure a notification system to automatically remove messages after a specified duration
Integrate a notification service with application components using provide/inject or composables
Manipulate the notification queue to add, remove, and clear messages programmatically
Apply conditional rendering to display notifications based on user interactions or API responses
Bind notification visibility to user actions like close buttons or automatic timeouts
Control notification positioning and styling using Vue's class and style bindings
